rationale: Create one manager-level Health Park at Avenir record rather than a pending Jupiter Medical Center campus transaction. Direct manager, registry, owner/developer and property-party evidence establishes SFG PBG Medical, LLC as the closed ProjectCo, Fengate/Fund IV, Stonemont and The Sina Companies as the investment and development partners, and Jupiter Medical Center as the 15-year tenant/operator. The bounded initial hospital and medical-office scope is under construction, and no later sale or signed ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.

afterImage.description: Health Park at Avenir is an investor-owned healthcare development in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, held through SFG PBG Medical, LLC. The bounded initial phase comprises an approximately 53,000-square-foot neighborhood hospital and approximately 47,000-square-foot medical office building that are fully pre-leased to Jupiter Medical Center for 15 years. Fengate Infrastructure Fund IV and affiliated entities invested alongside Stonemont Financial Group and The Sina Companies; public sources do not disclose the partners' percentages. The ProjectCo closed its land acquisition and construction financing before the June 24, 2026 groundbreaking, with opening targeted for early 2028. Jupiter Medical Center is the tenant/operator, Sina is an owner/developer, and later medical-office phases are excluded until common ownership is proven. No later sale or signed ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
